Resolves #5086

Adds `npm run move-files -- --from <path> --to <path>`: a read-only relocation plan by default, with explicit `--apply` after namespace, reference, collision and input-freshness checks. Moves update relative module references, canonical class names, existing SCSS companions and known boot/catalogue/layout/runtime carriers. Engine and consuming-workspace roots are supported; installed dependencies remain read-only.

Evidence: L3 (real CLI application in a temporary consuming workspace, fresh browser workers and native toolbar interaction) → L3 required (a moved example still boots and loads its data). No residual acceptance obligations.

| AC-2 · canonical class names | CI-covered: source and namespace-ownership specs cover declarations, JSDoc, namespace consumers and functional factories, with unrelated-binding controls. |

## Deltas from ticket

The shared `util/Theme` helper removes duplicated generator/runtime mapping and preserves nested `view` directories. Planning also covers source-relative URLs, literal package maps and functional components exposed by current-source falsifiers. Source-hash-bound domain declarations can admit disjoint computed references; six pinned native-reader sites have explicit carrier adapters. Moved boot and Canvas targets must remain reachable through their actual Webpack include/exclude rules; reader comments are included in the source pin and installed readers participate in freshness checks. Unknown callers, changed readers and intersecting domains remain blockers. There is no force option or claim to analyze arbitrary JavaScript dataflow or migrate external consumers.

The CI selector now admits the exact move CLI to both browser tiers because the new E2E spec executes it. Other create/helpers/release exclusions retain their reachability guard, including nonignored new specs before commit.

Handled write failures restore originals; retained backups identify a failed rollback. Application requires serialized writers and makes no crash-atomic guarantee.

The full Engine-tree `Progress.mjs` dry run still refuses 108 unresolved sites (6,130 files scanned, six native-reader sites admitted, no parse errors). The temporary Engine/workspace acceptance cases demonstrate complete supported moves; they do not certify arbitrary full-tree dataflow. [Retained probes and corrections](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/5086#issuecomment-6675831441).

## Test Evidence

`test/playwright/e2e/core/SourceMoveWorkspaceNL.spec.mjs` passed on local Chromium at 2026-11-06 05:38 UTC (11.1s), with the bundled-destination guards enabled. The CLI moved the actual six-file toolbar example two levels deeper in a temporary consumer workspace. Fresh identity-bound workers loaded it before/after; a native click produced nine toolbar items, eight buttons and a disabled trigger. Server receipts prove the JSON and source modules came from the moved workspace path, with no installed-example fallback or resource 404s. Screenshots and request/plan attachments are produced by the spec. Stylesheet equivalence is separately covered by the Sass fixtures.

Run with the explicit E2E config, `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT` pointing at a Brain checkout, and unused `NEO_NL_PORT` / `NEO_E2E_PORT` ports. The fixture owns and cleans its temporary workspace, server and isolated Bridge.

`agent-preflight`: not hosted here; repository formatting, shorthand, JSDoc parsing, source parsing, whitespace, test-domain and fixed-sleep checks ran. CI baseline jobs remain required.

### 🧭 Patch-Blind Premise Snapshot

*   **Inputs Read Before Patch:** #5086 (five operator requirements plus the 2026-11-06 implementation contract), the changed-file list, `dev`'s `buildScripts/create/scss.mjs` and `src/worker/App.mjs#insertThemeFiles` (two copies of the app theme-namespace rule, the generator's dropping every `view` segment), the sibling `buildScripts/create/*` CLIs, and the `buildScripts/util/` and `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/` layouts.
*   **Expected Solution Shape:** A `buildScripts/create/` CLI over importable plan/transform helpers. Grammar-based (Acorn) rewriting of module references, never regex. A read-only plan by default and an explicit apply that revalidates before writing. SCSS companions mapped by the runtime's own theme-namespace rule, extracted once rather than copied a third time. It must not hardcode the repository root, namespace roots or the theme list. Tests run in temporary trees and never write to the checkout.
*   **Patch Verdict:** Matches. `move.mjs` defaults to the dry run, and an `--options` file cannot enable apply or change the root. `movePlan.mjs#applyMove` re-checks blockers, the owned-tree snapshot and the read-only input hashes, then validates paths, refuses existing destinations, backs up rewrite originals and rolls back through a journal. `src/util/Theme.mjs#getThemeNamespace` replaces both copies: the App worker's mapping is byte-identical in behavior, and `create/scss` now strips only a leading `view`, as the runtime does. `planMove` realpaths the root, and the specs run in `mkdtemp` trees.
*   **Premise Coherence:** Coheres with the two-hemisphere organism: an engine-side tool that makes the backlog's own refactors (#9421) mechanical and checkable instead of hand-edited.
